text:
Lucy: hey team — ACME asked for our SOC 2 extracts and a bridge note for a POC next week. they want a PDF extract + presigned download. do we require an NDA before sharing the extract or can we send a redacted snapshot? they want turnaround within 48h. cc @Emily (Legal) @Jenna (Security)
Sanjay: short answer: we can produce a scoped extract (controls matrix + system description + testing period) and redact vendor/customer-specific identifiers. no prod keys or model weights ever.
Emily (Legal): we need a signed NDA before issuing presigned S3 links to any artifacts. for PDF extracts we can usually share a redacted "evidence snapshot" under our standard bridge-letter + temp access. i can send our NDA template now and a bridge-letter draft. need ACME legal contact (name + email).
Lucy: ACME legal contact is nina.patel@acme.com — they asked if our "bridge letter" can state 'no exceptions identified' as of date. also asked about scope: full Type II or snapshot?
Jenna (Security): we can do a scoped snapshot. minimum deliverables: 1) SOC 2 report cover page (redacted org IDs), 2) controls matrix for in-scope services, 3) sample test evidence (access logs, change control) — again redacted. bridge letter: operations signs, language limited to 'no exceptions observed in scope X for period Y'.
Emily (Legal): confirmed. i'll draft: NDA + bridge letter language: "Redwood Inference will provide a scoped SOC 2 extract and an interim bridge letter; material will be redacted for third-party identifiers and PII. Access to full artifacts requires NDA and audit handling agreement." i will send the NDA today.
Lucy: timeline check — can we get snapshot + presign within 24-48h once NDA back? ACME wants POC on Thu.
Sanjay: engineering can produce the snapshot in ~24h once security approves the exact scope. presigned S3 link creation is trivial: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-soc2/acme-snapshot-2026.pdf --expires-in 86400` — but we'll only generate after NDA signed.
Jenna (Security): i'll prepare the scope doc and sample redaction list. note: exclude internal admin usernames and 3rd-party vendor IPs. also need to ensure logs are rotated so no long-term PII leaks.
SecurityBot: Reminder: for external sharing of SOC artifacts, tag assets as `sensitive: soc2` and set ACL to private. Presigned links must be set to expire <= 7 days per policy. See runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/soc2-sharing
Emily (Legal): A couple of practicals: 1) ACME may request full report for legal review — escalate to SOC2-owner if that happens. 2) if ACME pushes for Bridge + attestation, we can only commit to language approved by ops/security. i'll send NDA + bridge draft in this thread.
Lucy: thanks — action items: Emily to send NDA + bridge draft; Jenna to prepare scope & redaction checklist; Sanjay to stand by for snapshot generation; Lucy will coordinate with ACME and aim to get signed NDA asap. please react when you're on it :thumbsup:
Sanjay: on it. :thumbsup:
Jenna (Security): prepping scope now.
Emily (Legal): NDA draft posted, sending to nina.patel@acme.com and cc'ing lucy. will update thread with signed timestamp.
Lucy: perfect, i'll ping ACME and update timeline. cheers everyone.
